_doc: Which supplier parts each head-carrier screw post is made of (Idle T-5bqc3m). The post positions are never typed: robot/body/neck-head/head_holes.py measures the bore of the named spacer (and of the terminal nut) on its mesh. group: screw family of the post; toward_plate: side of the spacer along its bore axis (oriented to +Y, the robot's back) on which the carrier plate lies; spacers / terminals / screws: manifest part names in post order (the legacy screw names stay so the assembly order and the part settings keep resolving; the screw and its length are regenerated); head: standard, thread, head dimensions and the length series the BOM already buys (ISO 10642 has no M2.5 entry in robot/body/checks/data/hardware.json, so dk / k are ISO 10642 values written here: assumption until compared with the supplier's list); sleeve: pressed-in 304 SS sleeve around the post (bore from robot/actuators/interfaces/standard-parts.json sleeve.bore_for, outer radius by the wall left at the head); terminal: where the thread bites (spacer thread half the spacer length deep from its plate end, M2 machine thread in an aluminium standoff; or the nut, depth = its thickness).
